_about: THE fleet roster - the one hand-maintained list of agents. The /week Fleet cards and Org Chart both build from this (served at GET /api/roster); `python -m fleet.roster` checks it against the dispatcher schedule in fleet/dispatch.py, which stays the sole authority on what actually runs. Edit here when an agent is added, retired, or changes cadence. Field notes: id = agent_name in agent_heartbeat AND the pause key in fleet_controls.json; cadence (machine-checked) = daily | weekdays | saturday | sunday | weekly | on-demand; fresh_hours = how old the last success may be before the dashboard turns amber (double it for red); log_names = extra agent_execution_logs names to roll into this card (defaults to [id]). Lane members either reference an agent by id (live heartbeat coloring) or are display-only seats with a fixed style: me | session | manual.

agents.name: Dispatcher
agents.desc: Railway daily cron that runs the due jobs as subprocesses — the schedule is the manager.

agents.name: Research (radar)
agents.desc: Weekly trend digest: HN + RSS + Exa scan, deduped vs last week.

agents.name: Reply pipeline
agents.desc: finder → judge → drafter; drafts wait at the founder gate, nothing auto-sends.

agents.name: Checks sweep
agents.desc: Opens outcome windows for anything newly published (idempotent sweep).

agents.name: Metrics snapshots
agents.desc: Daily raw numbers into metric_snapshots; closes due reply/post windows.

agents.name: Outcome checker
agents.desc: Reads real engagement for sent replies into reply_ledger — facts, never verdicts.

agents.name: Style distiller
agents.desc: Reads your edit diffs → proposes style rules (founder-gated, nothing auto-commits).

agents.name: Eval harness
agents.desc: Blind-judges fresh drafts vs your gold replies; win-rate per guide version.

agents.name: X batch generator
agents.desc: Weekly short-form batch → Typefully; you approve voice before anything schedules.

agents.name: Repurposer
agents.desc: Per clip: YT Short + X + IG (+ TikTok) packages → content_calendar drafts.

agents.name: X reply finder
agents.desc: Grok x_search eyes, Claude judges; runs inside the reply job when the X channel is enabled.
